csv_project_name: Architect for Senior Center In Laveen Development
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Phoenix is seeking a qualified consultant team to provide Architectural services for development of a new Senior Center in Laveen. Services will include full architectural design services and construction administration and observation services. The new Senior Center will be developed within an existing park in Laveen located near 35th Avenue and Baseline. The estimated construction cost is $9 million. Project Description The City seeks to develop an approximately 12,000 square foot senior center and related site improvements in the Parkway West location described in Attachment B - Feasibility Assessment, which will include multipurpose rooms, lobby / reception, commercial kitchen, fitness center and other necessary spaces. Site work will include, but is not limited to grading and drainage, parking / drop-off and landscaping. The program is further outlined in the attached Feasibility Assessment.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Feasibility Studies, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
